revisions.arc: arc-b7-v2 (books/book-07-void-roads/CHAPTER_ARCHITECTURE.md, editor PASS r4, Chapter 18 card)

knowledge_boundary: Cael is nineteen; ten + anomaly. Roster SIX; physically five south from Lowmarch until Millrace ford on the Stair road (one of Oryn's seven stops; EXC-B7-003), where Oryn is due the same day on her route; six from the ford. Lira one-armed.

Oryn at Millrace's clinic-shelter (a lean-to with a table) with a line of hold-people: three serious hurts and a dozen small (a carter's crushed hand, a child's fever, an old woman's knee) worked in the clinical register at her reserve's rate. Cael, who has the reading now, ASKS first and is told NO — she is working, he is not a healer, this is not a demonstration (the ask-first rule's first test: asked, refused, honored).

Her weighing, aloud, without heat: seven holds owe her and she owes them; a crew is walking into a floor where her Path dies; the one patient she has never been able to read is going in first; if she goes, Thornwater's next visit is eleven days late and somebody there might die of it. Fixed exchange: 'You're asking me to break the route.' / 'I'm not asking. I'm telling you where we'll be.' / 'That's worse. That's a healer's sentence.'

Her CHOICE: she does not join the crew; she sends word up the route (a carter, a note, the holds told she is eleven days late and why) and comes south — the crew made a stop on her route, not the reverse. 'You're on the route now. Which means when I say lie still, you lie still, and when I say I can't help you, you believe me.' The sixth chair filled on her terms of service.

On the road south she teaches Cael the reading properly for the first time — on HER, at her direction, her wrist in his hand, consent explicit — and he reads a Tide practitioner's architecture from inside: banks, a channel, a current that runs TO things; 'you're built to arrive' — and she looks at him the way patients look at a diagnosis that is correct. He asked; she said yes; the log records both. (This is a SURFACE-to-deep teaching at her pace; no new mechanics.)

The Long Stair's ridge at dusk: the line marked by Karis with a stone; beyond it a stair of the same grey stone descending into the ground from a floor with no ring; at its perimeter TWO survey stakes where the Ring had one — one weathered five years, one fewer. Seln: 'Newer. This one's been re-surveyed.' Nobody crosses the line in this chapter.
No theory; no fight; no trap sprung (Ch19).

purpose: Oryn's second arc chapter: her independent want given its full test with something she can actually lose, and the sixth chair filled on her terms — she does not join the crew; she makes the crew a stop on her route. The ask-first rule tested and honored, the reading taught on her at her direction, and the Long Stair sighted with two stakes at its edge.

scene_shape.opening_state: Millrace's ford; Oryn at the lean-to with a line of patients; the five arriving south with the contract.
scene_shape.pov_goal: Tell her where they will be without asking her to come; learn the reading from the only person who can teach it; reach the Stair.
scene_shape.opposition: The route's arithmetic and the people who might die of eleven days; her rule that the reading is not a demonstration; two stakes.
scene_shape.turn: The clinic scene (hers); Cael's ask refused; the contract explained; her weighing aloud; the fixed exchange.
scene_shape.choice: Hers: word sent up the route; south as a stop; the terms of service stated.
scene_shape.outcome: The road south: the reading taught on her, consent explicit, 'built to arrive'; the ridge at dusk; the stair; two stakes; Seln's line.
scene_shape.closing_state: The log at the fork, hours earlier (mid-scene): 'Oryn came. On her terms. She'll turn north the day she has to and I won't ask her not to.' Then the chapter ENDS ON AN IMAGE (the previous chapter ended on dialogue): the two stakes at the Stair's perimeter, iron, numbered, one weathered five years and one weathered fewer, and Seln on one knee between them, reading the difference with a thumb.

must_include: The clinic scene as HER scene (three serious hurts and a dozen small; her reserve spent in her arithmetic; the clinical register); Cael asking to read and being refused; the refusal honored.

Her weighing laid flat aloud (the four considerations) and the fixed exchange verbatim; her choice staged as a healer's, not a companion's (word sent up the route; south as a stop); her terms-of-service line verbatim.

The reading taught on Oryn at her direction with explicit consent; Cael's description ('banks, a channel, a current that runs to things'; 'you're built to arrive'); her reaction; the log recording that he asked and she said yes.
The mid-scene log line at the fork (as given).
The Stair sighted from the ridge at dusk: the line marked; the stair descending from a floor with no ring; TWO stakes; Seln's line verbatim.
The chapter ENDS on the two-stakes image with Seln's thumb.
Lira's arm carried; six on the road from Millrace.
Manuscript format: H1 '# Chapter 18 — Oryn's Choice', prose only, '---' breaks, ends on the last line of prose.
plants: Two stakes — re-surveyed (the Compact has been back; the trap).
Oryn's route made explicit as something she will break only on her terms (Ch23).
The reading taught (Ch21 refused in combat; Ch22 the three readings).
payoffs: Ch7's route and reserve arithmetic paid at full price.
prohibited_outcomes: Oryn does not 'join the crew'; the language is route/stop/terms.
No crossing of the Stair's line; no fight; no trap; no crossbows; nobody seen on the rim.
No fragment use except the consented reading on Oryn; no theory.
No Teague on the page (he is at Millrace in two days — after they leave); no letters, Vastin.
The chapter does not end on dialogue or a log entry.
No modern idiom; no feeling/growth declarations; tic caps; no metadata.
Do not use the phrase 'at the pitch' (or 'at that pitch') — it is at the book's cap already (10 uses in Chapters 1–4). Vary attribution registers with other means.

allowed: Millrace's lean-to clinic and its line of patients as texture; Oryn's hands and arithmetic; the road south; the ridge; the stair's shape at dusk; the stakes as objects.
Dialogue in established voices beyond the fixed lines.
Cael's interior during the taught reading (sensation; her architecture as shape).
approval_required: Any new named entity; any Tide mechanic beyond the taught readings; any fact about the Stair beyond what is visible from the ridge.
forbidden: Crossing the line; the trap; fights; theory; Oryn 'joining'; a dialogue or log ending; metadata.
